name: pl.agentrynku/gpw
title: Agent Rynku - Warsaw Stock Exchange (GPW) data for your agent
description: Public GPW daily prices, financials, ratios, company search, earnings calendar and WZA dividends.

tools.name: get_public_price_history
tools.description: Stored GPW daily OHLCV price history without an account. Returns the latest up to 500 candles within 1-3650 calendar days, in chronological order, with truncation, source, stored-series update timestamp and actual candle dates. Coverage may be shorter than requested. Per-candle priceScale and adjustment metadata are preserved; unknown means unrecorded, currency null means not recorded. Adjusted history can change after splits or dividends. No intraday, live quote or supplier fetch on demand. GPW equities only, excluding indices, ETFs and bonds; use ticker or ISIN.

symbol.description: GPW company ticker (for example PKNORLEN or KGHM), alias or ISIN.

days.description: Calendar days back from today to cover, 1-3650.

limit.description: Maximum number of most recent daily candles to return, 1-500.

tools.name: get_financial_ratios
tools.description: GPW quarterly financial ratios from published, quality-gated reports: EBITDA, operating, net profit margins, plus equity/assets. Each percentage includes its formula and report basis. Null means missing, withheld or nonpositive denominator. No price-based valuation multiples or TTM estimates.

symbol.description: GPW company ticker (for example PKNORLEN or KGHM), alias or ISIN.

quartersBack.description: How many most recent reported quarters to return, 1-20.

tools.name: get_public_dividends
tools.description: Odczytaj znane dywidendy GPW z WZA i zakwalifikowanych decyzji emitenta, w tym zaliczki. Zwraca kwotę jednego składnika, tożsamość i generację, rodzaj, okres obrotowy, Zarząd i zgodę RN, daty i pochodzenie. Łączna kwota roczna jest tylko kontekstem. Najnowsza kompletna generacja obejmuje anulowania. Approved i upływ terminu nie dowodzą wypłaty. asOf to odświeżenie, availableAt to dostępność generacji, sourcePublishedAt może być null. Brak wejściowego historycznego asOf. Ograniczone pokrycie, bez vendor i prognoz, pusty wynik nie dowodzi braku dywidendy.

symbol.description: GPW company ticker (for example PKNORLEN or KGHM), alias or ISIN.

limit.description: Maximum number of dividend components to return, 1-100.

tools.name: search_gpw_companies
tools.description: Find active GPW companies by name, ticker, alias or ISIN before requesting financial data. Returns canonical symbols, ISIN and public company URLs; does not search other markets. Results are bounded and truncated is explicit.

query.description: Company name, ticker, alias or ISIN, or a fragment of one (for example "orlen" or "PL0000000000").

limit.description: Maximum number of matching companies to return, 1-20.

tools.name: get_public_earnings_calendar
tools.description: Get known scheduled GPW reports over the next 1 to 90 days, including today in Warsaw. Covers the public market calendar, without a personal watchlist. Includes source and fetch date, removes dates superseded by published results, and declares truncation. An empty result is not proof that no companies will report.

daysAhead.description: How many days ahead to cover, counting today in Warsaw, 1-90.

limit.description: Maximum number of scheduled reports to return, 1-100.

tools.name: get_quarterly_kpis
tools.description: Quarterly financial KPIs of a GPW company: revenue, EBITDA, EBIT, net income, EPS, balance sheet and cash flow, reported and adjusted. Instruments resolve by ticker, alias or ISIN. Coverage varies by company and quarter, and missing data is not zero. Monetary `...PLN` fields are in millions of the issuer's reporting currency, given in the row's `currency` field, which can be EUR or USD; EPS fields are per share. `values.<field>` carries value, currency, unit, report date and source URL, and a field without complete provenance is absent. `dataQuality.blocksComputation: true` marks a row our checks do not trust. `withheld` lists fields returned as null by a data-quality rule, with the rule and reason; a null can also mean the field was excluded as not issuer-sourced. `reportScope` tells standalone from consolidated figures, and is null when unknown.

quartersBack.description: How many recent quarters to return. Default 8, max 20.
